sources.name: GitHub Trending
sources.method: Inspect the current public trending page; it is a discovery interface, not a stable rank API.
sources.signal: A directly observed appearance may be reported with date and rank; it is not a quality score.

sources.name: GitHub repository search
sources.method: Search public repositories for candidate discovery and category coverage.
sources.signal: Search results are leads only; verify each candidate at its canonical source.

policy: Discovery only; every candidate needs independent license, origin, status, relevance, and tradeoff review before active catalog inclusion.
